title: Dispatch RFU 6: Old Culvert Found to Be Drawing the Water
summary: The city prepares to reopen a drain sealed after the flood.
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Surveyors found a brick gate beneath Weaver Court. On their side it seals the old culvert; through the Institute’s comparison lens, water rushes against it from the vanished street. Dr. Saye believes the rising shower is the only path left for that water.

Opening the gate may send a flood into the present drains. Keeping it shut risks the growing cloud breaking over nearby roofs. Voss has ordered the lower shops evacuated and placed workers at the river outfall before attempting the release.
